image_description: A black, open ring binder lying flat on a textured grey surface. The binder features a leather-like texture with visible grain. It has metal corner protectors at all four corners of the open spread. A central vertical spine contains a clear plastic strip housing a metal ring mechanism (appearing to be a 2-ring or multi-ring setup obscured by the plastic). There are slip pockets on the lower half of both the left and right inner covers.

The metal corner pieces look slightly fused into the background or lack distinct thickness/shadows, appearing somewhat flat and inconsistently lit compared to the rest of the binder.
The reflection on the clear plastic strip over the rings is slightly inconsistent with the lighting direction of the rest of the object, causing minor visual confusion about the 3D shape.
